name: ops/execution-permit-consume-request-keyed-host-effect-digest-invalid
description: A8's demanded half (PROFILE.md §6.2 cross-boundary class rule): host_effect_digest offered as a well-constructed local_erasure_safe HMAC under the HOST's own per-object secret — the class byom used to demand. byom holds no such key, so that value is a blob it could only store; the rejection is typing-only (the offered ref is arithmetically well-formed for its class), and effect_outcome_admit already requires portable_public for the same field, so the two ends of one effect's life could never have named the same value.
